aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:810.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. As the home of three professional sports franchises – the NBA’s Los Angeles Lakers, the NHL’s LA Kings and the WNBA’s Los Angeles Sparks – Crypto.com Arena has proven to be a home court advantage for the local teams. alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:58d7d8e6-8.title: Base Labs Fellowship
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:58d7d8e6-8.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. ABOUT BASE LABS Base Labs is a research lab pushing the frontier of open-source LLMs. We think intelligence should be democratized, not controlled by a handful of closed labs and we think very few teams are actually positioned to do something about that. Backed by Baseten's training and inference infrastructure, we have the compute, resources, and talent to take on hard problems at the frontier and open-source what we learn along the way. Our mission is to help build a world where intelligence isn't concentrated, but spread across an ecosystem of models that anyone can build on. That mission shapes what we choose to work on, how we work on it, and who we want in the room. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for our first cohort of Base Labs Fellows, which is expected to start in late September. Apply using this link. BASE LABS FELLOWSHIP OVERVIEW The Base Labs Fellowship is designed to give researchers exposure to what frontier research looks like in industry. We provide funding, mentorship, and full support to our fellows, with the goal of producing rigorous, published research that shapes both the open-source ecosystem and Baseten's technical roadmap. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis. This application is for cohorts starting in Sept 2026 and beyond. WHAT TO EXPECT - 3 months of full-time research from our San Francisco office - A dedicated 1:1 mentorship from a senior researcher - $15,000 Stipend (per 3-months) - Funding for compute and other research expenses - Opportunities to publish and present at top venues, including ICML, NeurIPS, and Grace Hopper - A clear path to a full-time offer for the strongest performers YOUR MENTORS Each fellow is matched 1:1 with one of three senior researchers. Potential mentors include: - Michael Psenka - Max Kirkby - Charles O’Neill Note: You're welcome to research mentors' prior work, but all applications must go through the official process below, not the mentors directly. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR A quick note on our view on talent. Many of the labs that exist today run a credentialist talent model. Concentrate the most already-legible researchers, and assume the concentration compounds. The best researchers in this field are very often not yet legible. Research engineers who have spent years inside a production stack and developed insights no PhD program teaches; PhDs working on the wrong-shaped problem at the right-shaped lab; operators who have been close to real systems long enough to see things traditional researchers have never had to see. If you don’t have the usual qualifications and are doing exceptional work, we’d love to chat. For the sake of providing some directional criteria for potential fits for this fellowship: - Are enrolled in or have recently completed a PhD in ML, AI, statistics, or a closely related field - Have a publication record or research portfolio that demonstrates original, rigorous thinking - Care about what your work is in service of - not just the problem, but why it matters - Want to operate with autonomy and don't need a defined roadmap to do your best work - Are excited to be in San Francisco for the duration of the program, fully embedded in the team - Are drawn to the idea of building a research culture, not just participating in one WHY BASE LABS? - 1:1 by design. Three fellows, three me

interplay-interplay:ashbyhq:36633105-726.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Lykos
interplay-interplay:ashbyhq:36633105-726.description: Mechanical Engineering Lead, Advanced Manufacturing & Repair Systems Reports directly to: Chief Operating Officer Partners closely with: Head of Data & Software, CTO, Process Engineering Location: Atlanta, GA | U.S. Person required (ITAR) WHO ARE WE Lykos is a U.S.-based advanced materials and manufacturing company building a qualification-led repair & sustainment network for defense and aerospace industries. Lykos is focused on enabling rapid repair and sustainment for critical systems through advanced materials manufacturing, distributed and modular capacity, and our secure data-layer. THE OPPORTUNITY As Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will work directly with our COO and own advanced engineering for Lykos. You will own the hardware that turns our process science into repeatable processes: the machines, cells, fixtures, tooling, and automation that make up our pilot line and our modular manufacturing units. This is a builder's role, not a drafting role. You will design, procure, build, commission, and debug real hardware; additive and subtractive platforms, robotic material handling, thermal and laser processing equipment, and the instrumentation that makes all of it observable. You will work directly for Lykos’ COO and partner with our Head of Data & Software so that every machine we build is designed from the start to generate structured, trustworthy process data. You will be the first dedicated mechanical engineering leader at Lykos, setting the standards, own the discipline, help choose vendors and platforms we live with for years, and grow the mechanical team behind you. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING - Own mechanical engineering for Lykos end to end: architecture, design, analysis, build, commissioning, and sustaining engineering across the pilot line and modular manufacturing units. - Design and integrate additive manufacturing capability into ceramic and precursor workflows; including build platforms, material handling, thermal management, and post-process handling. - Own subtractive and finishing operations: CNC strategy, workholding and fixturing, tolerance stack-ups and GD&T, green- and fired-state machining approaches, and DFM feedback into component design. - Design and deploy automation and robotics: robotic cells, end effectors, motion systems, part transfer, machine tending, and vision-assisted handling. With the safety architecture and risk assessments to match. - Integrate laser-enabled processing hardware with ceramic material workflows, including optics mounting, motion control, enclosure design, thermal and fume management, and laser safety compliance. - Design the mechanical architecture of modular, transportable micro-factory units: envelope, utilities, containerization, serviceability, transport loads, and field installation. - Specify and instrument machines for data capture: sensors, thermal and load measurement, in-process monitoring, and machine interfaces. - Work with the Head of Data & Software so process data is structured, labeled, and usable for automation and machine learning from day one. - Build test, metrology, and inspection fixturing that supports qualification, NDT, and repeatable article-level evidence. - Run equipment selection and vendor execution: requirements, RFQs, build-to-print packages, technical reviews, FAT/SAT, acceptance criteria, and CAPEX justification alongside the COO. - Establish and enforce engineering discipline: drawing standards, revision and configuration control, ECO process, BOM and PLM structure, and documentation aligned with AS9100 and defense manufacturing expectations. - Identify and engineer out throughput constraints, yield killers, and cost inflection points before they become production problems. - Recruit, mentor, and lead a small mechanical engineering and technician team as the operation scales. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - First 90 days: you own the mechanical design baseline for the pilot line and have closed the highest-risk hardware unknowns. - First 6 months

launchtn-pilot-3-208c6413-9fd2-4901-97c9.title: Manager, Business Operations
launchtn-pilot-3-208c6413-9fd2-4901-97c9.description: The Role Pilot is building a first-of-its-kind, hybrid software/service solution to tackle the financial back office (bookkeeping, tax, CFO, etc.) so founders and business owners can focus on building and running their businesses. We work with thousands of customers in the tech startup and SMB sectors, and we're growing quickly. Customer Operations is made up of 150+ employees who partner with our customers to manage their financial back office and support their business goals. This is an individual contributor role reporting into the Head of Business Operations, working closely with Customer Operations service delivery teams, cross-functional partners, and peer Business Operations Managers. This role sits at the center of how we plan, allocate, and forecast work across the organization, and increasingly, how we automate that work. Pilot is moving fast toward agentic, AI-assisted operations, and this person will build and own the systems, models, and reporting that make that shift possible: work orchestration, KPI reporting, resource forecasting, and billing. This isn't a role for someone who wants to build one dashboard and maintain it. It's for someone who wants to keep building better systems as the work itself changes. The role requires real fluency with data and automation tools (Excel/Sheets at an expert level, plus a builder's instinct for where AI and scripts can replace manual work), sharp attention to detail, and good judgment about what results imply for our strategy and performance. This person works directly with senior leadership. This is a hybrid in-office role based in either our San Francisco or Nashville office. Key Responsibilities Work Orchestration: Own the systems and processes that plan and allocate work across the organization. Build and maintain the models that route work efficiently as volume, team capacity, and service lines change. KPI Reporting: Build and maintain reporting that gives leadership a clear, accurate, real-time view of business performance. Know the data well enough to catch anomalies before they become someone else's problem. Resource Forecasting: Build and maintain forecasting models that project staffing and capacity needs against demand. Translate forecasts into recommendations leadership can act on. Billing Operations: Own billing sheet accuracy and process, including the reconciliation and QA that keeps them error-free at scale. Automation & AI Adoption: Identify where manual, spreadsheet-based, or repetitive work can be automated or AI-assisted. Build these solutions directly rather than just recommending them, using tools like Excel/Sheets scripting, SQL, and emerging AI tooling. Process Optimization: Identify and implement improvements to the processes, workflows, and systems this role owns, so accuracy and efficiency improve as the business changes. When an improvement requires cross-functional buildout, lead it end to end, including the change management to get it adopted. About You Experience: 3-5 years in business operations, analytics, or finance, ideally in a start-up or technology-forward environment, with a track record of actually building and running a system. Experience owning forecasting, billing, or resource-planning is a strong plus. Technical Proficiency: Expert-level Excel/Sheets (formulas, modeling, automation/scripting), plus working proficiency in SQL and analytics tools (e.g., Looker). Comfort using AI tools like Claude Cowork. Detail Orientation: A track record of getting the numbers right the first time. Systems Thinking: Able to see how planning, allocation, forecasting, and billing connect, and to design solutions that account for the whole picture rather than one piece of it. Project Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading the build or overhaul of an operational system, including the change management needed to get a team to adopt it. Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work directly with senior leader

ventuals-ventuals:ashbyhq:e406d4e0-2a1f-.title: Founding Engineer – Full Stack
ventuals-ventuals:ashbyhq:e406d4e0-2a1f-.description: At Ventuals http://ventuals.com, we’re building onchain markets that enable anyone to get exposure to technological progress and adoption — starting with perpetual futures for pre-IPO companies. Private equities are a $13+ trillion asset class that retail has been locked out of for too long. Top startups have stayed private for longer than ever, leaving no way for everyday investors to participate in their growth. Ventuals makes private markets public — enabling anyone to trade top private companies like OpenAI, SpaceX, Anthropic, and Stripe. We’re building on Hyperliquid, and have had amazing testnet traction in the 2 months since launch, with ~10,000 weekly active traders and >1M cumulative trades, and zero marketing spend. Our seed round was led by Paradigm, with additional angels from Coinbase Ventures, Electric Capital, Ethereum Foundation, Uniswap, and Flashbots. Our small, world-class team is mostly based in New York, and we often work out of a beautiful office in Soho with other early-stage Paradigm portfolio companies. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a senior or staff-level engineer to join Ventuals ahead of our mainnet launch. You’ll be shaping the user experience, trading systems, and infrastructure that our users will interact with on day one. As a generalist, you’ll work across the entire stack – from shipping frontend features on our Next.js http://next.js app, to building core trading APIs, to scaling the infrastructure that power our exchange. WHAT YOU'LL DO (RESPONSIBILITIES) We're looking for an experienced IC who wants to: - Ship user-facing features in TypeScript, React, and Next.js http://next.js - Build backend services that power our exchange, including trading, market data, indexing, and monitoring systems - Help shape the product roadmap and strategy alongside the founders and the rest of the team WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (QUALIFICATIONS) You're a senior or staff-level IC that has built technical user-facing products before. We’re looking for someone that feels a deep sense of duty to the users of their work. - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment - Strong track record of ownership and high-agency execution - Pragmatic builder who can write clean, maintainable code but knows when to move fast - Excellent written and verbal communication; strong technical documentation skills - Curiosity and adaptability; willing to dive into new technical domains quickly WHY JOIN - Work on a frontier product with clear, proven user demand - High autonomy and outsized impact as one of the first engineers - Be part of a high-performance, low-ego culture that values grit, excellence, and execution - Partner directly with founders on product and technical strategy WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH Emily https://linkedin.com/in/hsiaemily (Co-Founder and CTO) — Previously CTO at Shadow, Paradigm EIR, and Staff Engineer → Engineering Manager at Airbnb, where she built the realtime indexer for user profiling used sitewide and managed a team of 15 engineers. Has been highly active onchain since DeFi summer 2020. Alvin https://linkedin.com/in/alvinhsia (Co-Founder and CEO) — Previously CEO at Shadow, Paradigm EIR, and Designer → Staff Product Manager at Airbnb, where he was the first PM on Airbnb Plus and helped take it from a whiteboard idea to a $100M/yr business in 2.5 years. Has been highly active onchain since DeFi Summer 2020. Emily and Alvin are siblings and have worked together for the past 10 years! WHAT WE OFFER (COMPENSATION & BENEFITS) Highly competitive salary and equity — we target 90th percentile compensation for both salary and equity. You’ll be expected to act like an owner, because you are one. Great healthcare — gold-tier company healthcare plans. We cover 99% of medical, dental, vision premiums for employees, and 50% for dependents. 401k — flexible 401k retirement plan with contribution matching. Hardware setup — we’ll buy whatever you need to be productive.
